years: c. 2016-2022 (disposition sheet 2016; now a legacy model)
notes: Stop names are the tab labels ('Stop' column of the disposition sheet). The organ has four styles (Baroque, Barock, Romantic, Symphonic) that rename and revoice the stops.
Couplers and tremulants are not in the disposition sheet; they come from the Chorum manual's panel description (2-manual models: I/P, II/P, II/I, a tremulant on each manual).
Orchestral voice tabs (Cello, Piano, Strings, Chimes etc.) are included as stops; their footage is nominal (8', Cello 16').
ARTEM sampled organ (Chorum series), not Physis.
The internal sequencer's MIDI files use a different channelling (Pedal 1, Man.I 2, Man.II 3; manual p. 40). This template follows the live MIDI OUT defaults of sect. 10.6.

Stops transmit Viscount SysEx F0 31 4n xx yy F7 (on) / F0 31 0n xx yy F7 (off), n = section channel, xx yy = internal voice ID. Voice IDs are not published for this model (and change if an alternative voice is selected), so no stop bindings are included: use Learn every stop.

Couplers are only received (F0 31 2F 70 vv F7), not transmitted; tremulant on/off is sent as tremulant speed/depth SysEx (depth 00 = off), which a stop binding cannot express. Learn or set these by hand.
all_stops_off is the documented Viscount Cancel message F0 31 2F 6C 00 F7. Expression pedals send CC11 (0-127) on the section's channel; divisional volumes send CC7 (not mapped).
Check on your organ: the channel numbers are factory defaults and can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu (a dealer may have changed them).

Stop list: https://www.viscountinstruments.it/media/wysiwyg/pdf/supporto/Disposition/Chorum/Chorum%2050%20EU%20-%20Disposition.pdf (official Viscount disposition sheet; no longer on viscountinstruments.it, retrieved from the Internet Archive copy)

Stop list: https://www.viscountinstruments.com/products/classics/classic-organs/legacy-organs/chorum-50-dlx-chorum-s50/ (2 x 61 notes, 30-note pedalboard, 38 stops + 3 orchestral voices, one expression pedal for Man.II)

MIDI scheme: https://chci-varhany.cz/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Chorum-EU-EN-v14-1.pdf (Chorum User Manual EU-EN v14, OS 1.1.5; official copy https://www.viscountinstruments.it/img/Chorum-EU-EN-v14-1-1.pdf) - sect. 10.6 Detailed MIDI implementation, pp. 55-58: 2-manual defaults Man.II=ch1, Man.I=ch2, Pedal=ch4, ch16 system; Register on/off F0 31 sn xx yy F7; Cancel F0 31 2F 6C 00 F7; sect. 5.4 MIDI settings pp. 21-23
